heuristicIssues.issue: Disable/Enable is a single click that fires an immediate PATCH with no confirmation, and nothing stops an admin from disabling their own account or the last ADMIN.
heuristicIssues.evidence: AdminUsersOperationsPage.tsx:224 (onClick -> setActive(user, !user.is_active)), :144-157 (PATCH with no guard); counts.admins is computed at :66 but never used as a guard; the same gap exists for role edits: saveRoles only checks roles.length === 0 at :123-125, so an admin can remove ADMIN from themselves.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Open the existing ModalDialog primitive for Disable (name the user, state 'they will not be able to sign in'); disable the Disable button and the ADMIN chip when user.id === me.id; block or warn when counts.admins === 1 and the target holds ADMIN.

heuristicIssues.issue: Unsaved role edits on any row are silently discarded whenever load() runs: after saving another user's roles, toggling Disable/Enable, creating an account, or pressing Refresh.
heuristicIssues.evidence: AdminUsersOperationsPage.tsx:49 rebuilds draftRoles from the server response; load() is called at :113, :136, :151 and by the Refresh button at :206; the row shows no 'unsaved' indicator (only the Save roles button enables at :218/:224).
heuristicIssues.recommendation: In load(), merge: keep a draft when it differs from the previous saved roles for that user; show an 'Unsaved' pill on dirty rows; confirm before Refresh/Create when any row is dirty.

heuristicIssues.issue: Validation bug: an empty Post mile passes the check because Number('') is 0 and Number.isFinite(0) is true, so the lookup silently queries PM 0.000 while the error copy claims a numeric post mile is required.
heuristicIssues.evidence: RoadInventoryLookupPanel.tsx:15-17 (const pm = Number(postmile); if (!county.trim() || !route.trim() || !Number.isFinite(pm))).
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Guard on postmile.trim() === '' before Number(); mark the three required fields visually (asterisk/required attribute) so the optional District is distinguishable.

heuristicIssues.issue: After a successful import the only pointer to the new pending version is 'Dataset #<id> is pending publication'; the Publish button lives in a different table further down, keyed by the same bare integer in a muted '#id' column, so the admin must scroll and match numbers.
heuristicIssues.evidence: RoadInventoryImportPanel.tsx:154 (Dataset #{dataset_version_id}); history 'Dataset' column is the raw id at :165; the versions table shows #{version.id} at :195 and the Publish button at :196; no link or highlight connects them.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Render 'Publish version <tag>' directly in the success card (lift the setAction handler via a prop), or scroll to and highlight the new row; replace ids with version tags in both places.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Match between system and the real world
heuristicIssues.issue: Section order runs against the import -> publish -> regenerate-package workflow: the package Generate/Regenerate control is at the top, import is in the middle, the versions table with Publish is below it, and the confirmation dialog then tells the admin to go back up and regenerate.
heuristicIssues.evidence: RoadInventoryWorkspacePage.tsx:146-179 (package card), :181 (import panel), :183-202 (versions), :204 (lookup); RoadInventoryVersionActionDialog.tsx:67 ('After this change, regenerate the mobile road-inventory package…') with no button to do so.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Reorder to Import -> Versions -> Mobile package -> Verify, and after a successful publish/rollback render the notice with an inline 'Regenerate package' action (call generatePackage from the notice).

heuristicIssues.issue: One global busy boolean drives every control, so any single request disables all rows, Refresh and Create, and the Refresh button reads 'Refreshing…' while a password reset or role save is in flight.
heuristicIssues.evidence: AdminUsersOperationsPage.tsx:32 (single busy), :199, :206 ('Refreshing…' bound to busy), :224 (all row buttons disabled by busy), :233 (dialog busy = page busy), :161 (resetPassword sets the same flag).
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Split into loading, creating and rowBusyId (as RoadInventoryWorkspacePage already does at :44-46); only the acting row and the dialog show progress.

heuristicIssues.issue: Success/error banners render at the top of each page, far from the table row or button that triggered them, never auto-dismiss, and are not live regions so screen readers are not told a save succeeded or failed.
heuristicIssues.evidence: AdminUsersOperationsPage.tsx:209-210 (banners above table; actions at :224); RoadInventoryWorkspacePage.tsx:143-144 (banners above a ~5-screen page; triggers at :175, :196); only PasswordResetDialog.tsx:63 uses role=alert.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Add role=status/aria-live=polite to notice and role=alert to error; render mutation feedback as a toast anchored to the viewport or inline under the affected row; auto-dismiss success after ~6s.

heuristicIssues.issue: While a job runs the only progress cue is the raw backend 'stage' string in monospace, there is no spinner or elapsed time, and polling continues every 2s forever if the job never reaches a terminal state; there is no cancel.
heuristicIssues.evidence: RoadInventoryImportPanel.tsx:152 ({currentJob.stage} in font-mono), :73-86 (setInterval 2000 with no timeout/attempt cap), :83-85 (errors swallowed silently).
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Map stage codes to labels, add an animated spinner + 'Started 0:42 ago', cap polling (e.g. 10 min) and then show 'Still processing - check Recent import history', and surface repeated poll failures.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Help users recognize, diagnose, and recover from errors
heuristicIssues.issue: A single error state is shared by 'load history' and 'start import', so a history-load failure appears in the same banner as an upload failure and vice versa; the file input is also cleared immediately on submit, so a failed job requires re-picking the file.
heuristicIssues.evidence: RoadInventoryImportPanel.tsx:51 (one error), :58 (history failure), :104 (submit failure), :97-99 (file/tag cleared right after createRoadInventoryImportJob).
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Add a separate historyError shown next to the history heading; keep the selected file until the job reaches succeeded, and offer 'Retry import' on failed.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Match between system and the real world
heuristicIssues.issue: Internal identifiers and raw enum codes leak into the UI: 'User #id' on every row, '#id' versions column, 'Dataset ID' in the confirmation dialog, truncated job UUIDs and bare dataset ids in import history, raw role codes as chip tooltips and in the AppShell header ('ADMIN · GEOTECH_ENGINEER'), and an 'ADMIN role' hint under 'Administrators'.
heuristicIssues.evidence: AdminUsersOperationsPage.tsx:221, :244 (title={role}), :176; RoadInventoryWorkspacePage.tsx:195; RoadInventoryVersionActionDialog.tsx:47; RoadInventoryImportPanel.tsx:165; AppShell.tsx:157 (me.roles.join(' · ')).
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Drop ids from the tables and dialog (keep them in a title attribute or a details drawer); use roleLabel() in AppShell; change the hint to 'Hold the Admin role'.

heuristicIssues.screen: Road Inventory Workspace; Import panel; Confirmation dialog
heuristicIssues.issue: The same facts are named differently across the page: 'Not ready' vs 'Not generated' for the package; 'Segments' vs 'Rows' for row_count; 'Uploaded' vs 'Created' for created_at; 'Published' badge plus 'Authoritative' text on the same row; 'Refresh' / 'Refresh state' / 'Refresh history'.
heuristicIssues.evidence: RoadInventoryWorkspacePage.tsx:138 vs :166; :137, :157 vs :192 and RoadInventoryVersionActionDialog.tsx:48; RoadInventoryWorkspacePage.tsx:192 vs RoadInventoryImportPanel.tsx:164; RoadInventoryWorkspacePage.tsx:196; AdminUsersOperationsPage.tsx:206, RoadInventoryWorkspacePage.tsx:131, RoadInventoryImportPanel.tsx:118.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Adopt one glossary: 'Segments', 'Not generated', 'Uploaded', plain 'Refresh'; remove the redundant 'Authoritative' text since the badge and row tint already say it.

heuristicIssues.issue: Version tag, segment count, package readiness and generated date are each rendered twice (summary cards vs authoritative section/package card), and the top of the page stacks three heading-like lines (h1 'Road Inventory', eyebrow 'Authoritative roadway reference', h2 'Road inventory operations').
heuristicIssues.evidence: RoadInventoryWorkspacePage.tsx:137-138 vs :156-157, :166, :170; :121 (AppShell title), :126-127.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Keep the summary cards as the at-a-glance layer and reduce the authoritative section to Extract date, Published, package details and the Generate button; delete the eyebrow and h2.

heuristicIssues.issue: The 'ERIS access management' card restates the page title and lists the buttons already visible below; it exists only to host the New account toggle, and the create form then offers three ways to dismiss it (header toggle, top Cancel, bottom Cancel).
heuristicIssues.evidence: AdminUsersOperationsPage.tsx:185-188 (card + toggle), :192 (top Cancel), :199 (bottom Cancel).
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Move 'New account' into the filter row next to Refresh, delete the card, and keep one Cancel in the form footer.

heuristicIssues.issue: No password policy hint or strength feedback and no show-password toggle on either password entry; the admin learns the server's rules only after a failed submit.
heuristicIssues.evidence: AdminUsersOperationsPage.tsx:196 (Initial password, no hint); PasswordResetDialog.tsx:56, :60 (inputs), :22-29 (only empty and mismatch are validated).
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Show the policy under the field (e.g. 'At least 12 characters'), validate client-side, add a show/hide toggle, and consider a 'Generate' button for initial passwords.

heuristicIssues.issue: No <form> element anywhere: every submit is a type=button onClick, so pressing Enter in the create-account fields, the search box, the password dialog, the import tag field or the lookup fields does nothing.
heuristicIssues.evidence: AdminUsersOperationsPage.tsx:193-199, :204; PasswordResetDialog.tsx:53-68; RoadInventoryImportPanel.tsx:122-145; RoadInventoryLookupPanel.tsx:39-45.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Wrap each group in <form onSubmit={e => { e.preventDefault(); submit(); }}> and make the primary button type=submit; keep Cancel in the confirmation dialog as initial focus so Enter there still cancels.

heuristicIssues.screen: User Administration; Road Inventory Workspace; Import panel; Lookup panel
heuristicIssues.issue: Accessibility gaps: search input and status select have no accessible name; role chips hide the checkbox with sr-only and give the label no focus-visible style; tables have no caption; horizontal scroll containers are not keyboard-focusable; busy states are text-only without aria-busy.
heuristicIssues.evidence: AdminUsersOperationsPage.tsx:204-205 (placeholder only), :244-245 (sr-only input, no focus ring on label), :213; RoadInventoryWorkspacePage.tsx:190; RoadInventoryImportPanel.tsx:162; RoadInventoryLookupPanel.tsx:51.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Add aria-label='Search users' / 'Filter by status'; add has-[:focus-visible]:ring-2 to the chip label; add <caption class='sr-only'>; put tabIndex={0} and aria-label on every overflow-x-auto wrapper; set aria-busy on the table while loading.

heuristicIssues.issue: Generate/Regenerate mobile package fires immediately with no confirmation even though regeneration replaces the artifact field devices download; 'Download package' opens a new tab with no indicator.
heuristicIssues.evidence: RoadInventoryWorkspacePage.tsx:175 (onClick={generatePackage}, no dialog), :172 (target=_blank, no icon/sr text).
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Confirm when packageReady is true ('Replace the package generated on <date>?'); add an external-link icon and sr-only '(opens in a new tab)' to the download link.

heuristicIssues.issue: Results show 17 columns of raw inventory codes (PM prefix, surface, terrain, median) with no legend, in text-xs, for what is fundamentally a 'does it resolve?' check.
heuristicIssues.evidence: RoadInventoryLookupPanel.tsx:53-54 (17 headers; values such as pm_prefix_code, left_surface_type, terrain_code rendered verbatim).
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Show District, County, Route, PM prefix, Begin PM, End PM by default and put the remaining attributes in an expandable detail row with humanized labels/tooltips for codes.

heuristicIssues.issue: The count cards are static (not clickable as filters), and the table has no sort or pagination; the whole user list renders in one table with client-side filtering only.
heuristicIssues.evidence: AdminUsersOperationsPage.tsx:176-182 (cards without onClick), :69-80 (client-side filter), :213-229 (no sort headers, no paging).
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Make Active/Inactive/Administrators cards set statusFilter/query; add sortable Name/Status headers; paginate or virtualize once the list exceeds ~50 rows.

heuristicIssues.issue: The version-tag format guidance lives only in a placeholder that disappears on typing, and the field is not disabled while busy although the file input is.
heuristicIssues.evidence: RoadInventoryImportPanel.tsx:140 (placeholder 'Optional, e.g. 2026-08-17', no helper text), :129 vs :140 (disabled only on the file input).
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Add persistent helper text ('Optional. Defaults to the extract date, e.g. 2026-08-17') and disable the field while busy.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Help users recognize, diagnose, and recover from errors
heuristicIssues.issue: Rollback copy degrades when no version is currently published: 'The currently published version  will be superseded by the rollback.' with an empty name and double space.
heuristicIssues.evidence: RoadInventoryVersionActionDialog.tsx:61-62 (currentPublished ? … : null inside a fixed sentence).
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Branch the sentence: when currentPublished is null say 'No version is currently published; <tag> will become authoritative.'

heuristicIssues.screen: Publish / Rollback Confirmation Dialog; Road Inventory Workspace
heuristicIssues.issue: Inconsistent verb form for the same action: 'Rollback' as a verb in the title, button and row action, 'Rolled back' in the notice, 'Confirm rollback' on the primary button.
heuristicIssues.evidence: RoadInventoryVersionActionDialog.tsx:26, :71; RoadInventoryWorkspacePage.tsx:107, :196.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Use 'Roll back to <tag>' for the title and button and 'Roll back' for the row action.

heuristicIssues.issue: SHA-256 is truncated to 16 hex characters with an ellipsis and no copy affordance, so it cannot be used to verify a downloaded package.
heuristicIssues.evidence: RoadInventoryWorkspacePage.tsx:171 (manifest.package.sha256.slice(0, 16)).
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Add a 'Copy checksum' button that writes the full hash to the clipboard and show the full value in a title/details element.

heuristicIssues.issue: 'Dataset ID' repeats an internal id already in the table and 'Current status' restates the button that was clicked (only pending rows get Publish, only superseded get Rollback).
heuristicIssues.evidence: RoadInventoryVersionActionDialog.tsx:47, :49; gating at RoadInventoryWorkspacePage.tsx:196.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Reduce the dl to Target version, Segments, Extract date (add extract_date, which is the fact an admin actually checks before publishing).

heuristicIssues.issue: Button and badge styling drifts between files: primary buttons sometimes have hover:brightness-95 and sometimes not; row buttons are 'rounded' in Users but 'rounded-md' in Road Inventory; three hand-rolled status badges use three different sizes; the dialog close 'x' is duplicated verbatim.
heuristicIssues.evidence: AdminUsersOperationsPage.tsx:187, :199, :224, :12-18; RoadInventoryWorkspacePage.tsx:175, :196, :30-38; RoadInventoryImportPanel.tsx:30-40, :142; RoadInventoryLookupPanel.tsx:44; RoadInventoryVersionActionDialog.tsx:41, :71; PasswordResetDialog.tsx:50, :67.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Introduce Button (variant/size), Badge (tone) and DialogHeader primitives under web/src/ui and use them in all six files.

responsiveIssues.issue: The 4-column users table has no min-width; in ~279px of content width the Roles cell collapses to one chip per line (6+ lines per row), the text-xs email cannot wrap so the table widens and scrolls horizontally inside overflow-auto, and the right-aligned Actions column (Save roles / Reset password / Disable) ends up off-screen with no scroll cue.
responsiveIssues.evidence: AdminUsersOperationsPage.tsx:212 (flex-1 overflow-auto), :213 (w-full table, no min-w), :221 (email in text-xs, no break-words), :223 + :240 (RoleChoices flex-wrap), :224 (inline-flex flex-wrap justify-end actions).
responsiveIssues.fix: Below md render each user as a card (name/email, status badge, assigned-role chips summary, a 'Roles' button opening a popover, and the three actions in a full-width row); at md+ keep the table but add min-w-[840px], make the Actions cell 'sticky right-0 bg-[var(--panel)]' and add tabIndex={0} on the scroll container.

responsiveIssues.issue: Below lg (1024px) AppShell renders the full sidebar as a 'Navigation' card stacked above the page content, so on phones and portrait iPads the count cards/summary cards start roughly one screen down on every visit; there is no drawer or hamburger.
responsiveIssues.evidence: AppShell.tsx:164 (<aside className='lg:hidden'> with SidebarNavigation), :165 (real sidebar hidden lg:block).
responsiveIssues.fix: Replace the stacked card with a header menu button that opens an off-canvas drawer (or a collapsed <details> summary 'Navigation'), keeping the current page title visible at the top; this is a shell change that fixes every non-workspace page at once.

responsiveIssues.issue: Touch targets are undersized: row action buttons are ~28px tall (py-1.5 text-xs) and role chips ~24px (py-1 text-[11px]) with 6px gaps, well under the 44px guideline, and chips rely on hover title tooltips that touch cannot show.
responsiveIssues.evidence: AdminUsersOperationsPage.tsx:224 (px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs), :244 (px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px], title={role}), :240 (gap-1.5).
responsiveIssues.fix: Use min-h-10 py-2 text-sm on buttons and py-1.5 text-xs gap-2 on chips below md (e.g. 'py-1.5 md:py-1'); drop the raw-code title attribute.

responsiveIssues.issue: At 768px the create form's md:grid-cols-3 yields roughly 200px-wide Email/Full name/Password inputs inside ~640px of content, too tight for typical Caltrans emails.
responsiveIssues.fix: Change to 'md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3' and let Email span both columns at md (md:col-span-2).

responsiveIssues.issue: The mobile-package card has a fixed min-w-72 (288px); at 375px only ~279px of content width remains (shell px-4, page p-4, section p-4), so the card spills into the section padding, and at 360px it crosses the section border; below ~345px it is clipped by the product-card's overflow-hidden.
responsiveIssues.fix: Replace min-w-72 with 'w-full min-w-0 lg:w-72 lg:shrink-0' so the card is fluid until the lg:flex-row layout applies.

responsiveIssues.issue: The dataset versions table has 9 columns with Actions (Publish/Rollback) last; on phone and portrait tablet it scrolls horizontally with the primary actions hidden off-screen and no scroll affordance, and at exactly 1024px (tablet landscape) the 256px sidebar appears and pushes the content to ~700px so the same overflow starts on desktop-class widths too. The scroll container is not keyboard-focusable.
responsiveIssues.evidence: RoadInventoryWorkspacePage.tsx:190 (overflow-x-auto, no tabIndex), :192 (9 <th>), :196 (Actions last); AppShell.tsx:165 (w-64 sidebar at lg).
responsiveIssues.fix: Reorder columns to Version, Status, Actions, Segments, Extract, Uploaded, then Source file, Skipped; hide ID entirely and give Source file/Skipped 'hidden xl:table-cell'; add tabIndex={0} and a right-edge fade on the wrapper; below md render versions as cards with the action button full-width.

responsiveIssues.issue: The page is a ~5-screen vertical stack (header, cards, banners, authoritative dataset, import + history, versions, lookup) with no in-page navigation; the notice for a publish/rollback appears at the top while the admin is at the versions table near the bottom.
responsiveIssues.evidence: RoadInventoryWorkspacePage.tsx:122-205 (single flex-col stack), :143-144 (banners near the top), :196 (Publish/Rollback at the bottom).
responsiveIssues.fix: Show mutation feedback as a fixed toast (bottom on phone) and add a sticky in-page tab strip (Overview / Import / Versions / Verify) under the h1, or split the sections into tabs.

responsiveIssues.screen: Password Reset Dialog; Publish / Rollback Confirmation Dialog
responsiveIssues.issue: In phone landscape (812x375) the confirmation dialog (eyebrow, title, 4-row dl stacked to one column, two paragraphs, footer ~540px tall) exceeds the viewport, and the ModalDialog panel has no max-height or overflow-y-auto, so the Confirm button cannot be reached; body scroll is locked.
responsiveIssues.evidence: ModalDialog.tsx:25-26 (overlay p-4, panel without max-h/overflow), :47 (body overflow hidden); RoadInventoryVersionActionDialog.tsx:34 (max-w-xl), :45 (sm:grid-cols-2 stacks below 640px).
responsiveIssues.fix: Add 'max-h-[calc(100dvh-2rem)] overflow-y-auto' to the default panelClassName in ModalDialog and to both custom panelClassName strings.

responsiveIssues.issue: At 768px the md grid 'minmax(260px,1fr) 220px auto' needs ~614px inside ~640px of content, so the file input is pinned at its 260px minimum and the native 'Choose File' control plus filename truncate; in the current-job card the ml-auto stage text wraps under the filename on narrow widths.
responsiveIssues.fix: Use 'md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(260px,1fr)_220px_auto]' with the button 'md:col-span-2 md:justify-self-end lg:col-span-1'; move the stage label to its own line under the filename (or replace it with a labelled progress row).

responsiveIssues.issue: The 7-column history table scrolls horizontally with no hint; job UUID and filename reveal their full values only via hover title, which touch cannot trigger.
responsiveIssues.evidence: RoadInventoryImportPanel.tsx:162 (overflow-x-auto, no tabIndex), :164 (7 <th>), :165 (title={job.job_uuid}, title={job.upload_filename}, max-w-60 truncate).
responsiveIssues.fix: Drop the Job column, give Finished 'hidden md:table-cell', let the filename wrap with break-all below md, and add tabIndex={0} on the wrapper.

responsiveIssues.issue: Between sm (640px) and lg (1024px) the form is a 2-column grid with five cells, so 'Run lookup' lands alone on a third row, stretched to half width and aligned with nothing.
responsiveIssues.evidence: RoadInventoryLookupPanel.tsx:39 (grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-[140px_140px_160px_160px_auto] lg:items-end), :44 (button as the fifth grid child).
responsiveIssues.fix: Add 'sm:col-span-2 sm:justify-self-end lg:col-span-1' to the button (or use sm:grid-cols-[1fr_1fr_auto] with District spanning).

responsiveIssues.issue: The 17-column results table with whitespace-nowrap headers needs ~1500px, so it scrolls horizontally even at 1440px desktop once the 256px sidebar is subtracted (~1050px content); on phone it is several screens of sideways scrolling, and the Landmark value is hover-only.
responsiveIssues.evidence: RoadInventoryLookupPanel.tsx:51 (overflow-x-auto), :53 (whitespace-nowrap on 17 headers), :54 (max-w-52 truncate title=landmark); AppShell.tsx:165 (w-64 sidebar).
responsiveIssues.fix: Default to the six essential columns with an 'Expand' row toggle for the rest; make the Route column 'sticky left-0' so the row stays identifiable while scrolling.

responsiveIssues.issue: Summary card values (version tag) truncate with a hover-only title, so a long tag is unreadable on touch devices in the 2x2 card grid.
responsiveIssues.fix: Use 'break-all text-lg leading-tight' below lg instead of truncate, or shorten tags at the source; never rely on title for essential values.

responsiveIssues.issue: At 1024x768 (tablet landscape, exactly lg) the sidebar expands to 256px by default, leaving ~700px for a users table whose Roles chip cloud is allowed up to max-w-3xl and for the 9-column versions table; the collapse button exists but the default is expanded.
responsiveIssues.fix: Default navExpanded to false when window.innerWidth < 1280 (persist the choice in UiSettingsContext) and apply the column hiding described above at lg, showing all columns only at xl.
